options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: auto_devops_enabled
options.description: Default to Auto DevOps pipeline for all projects within this group.

options.name: avatar_path
options.description: Absolute path image to configure avatar. File size should not exceed 200 kb. This option is only used on creation, not for updates.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: default_branch
options.description: All merge requests and commits are made against this branch unless you specify a different one.

options.name: description
options.description: A description for the group.

options.name: enabled_git_access_protocol
options.description: V(all) means SSH and HTTP(S) is enabled. V(ssh) means only SSH is enabled. V(http) means only HTTP(S) is enabled. Only available for top level groups.

options.name: force_delete
options.description: Force delete group even if projects in it. Used only when O(state=absent).

options.name: lfs_enabled
options.description: Projects in this group can use Git LFS.

options.name: lock_duo_features_enabled
options.description: Enforce GitLab Duo features for all subgroups. Only available for top level groups.

options.name: membership_lock
options.description: Users cannot be added to projects in this group.

options.name: mentions_disabled
options.description: Group mentions are disabled.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the group you want to create.

options.name: parent
options.description: Allow to create subgroups. ID or Full path of parent group in the form of group/name.

options.name: path
options.description: The path of the group you want to create, this is O(api_url)/O(path). If not supplied, O(name) is used.

options.name: prevent_forking_outside_group
options.description: Prevent forking outside of the group.

options.name: prevent_sharing_groups_outside_hierarchy
options.description: Members cannot invite groups outside of this group and its subgroups. Only available for top level groups.

options.name: project_creation_level
options.description: Determine if developers can create projects in the group.

options.name: request_access_enabled
options.description: Users can request access (if visibility is public or internal).

options.name: require_two_factor_authentication
options.description: Require all users in this group to setup two-factor authentication.

options.name: service_access_tokens_expiration_enforced
options.description: Service account token expiration. Changes do not affect existing token expiration dates. Only available for top level groups.

options.name: share_with_group_lock
options.description: Projects cannot be shared with other groups.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete group. Possible values are present and absent.

options.name: subgroup_creation_level
options.description: Allowed to create subgroups.

options.name: two_factor_grace_period
options.description: Delay 2FA enforcement (hours).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.

options.name: visibility
options.description: Default visibility of the group.

options.name: wiki_access_level
options.description: V(enabled) means everyone can access the wiki. V(private) means only members of this group can access the wiki. V(disabled) means group-level wiki is disabled.
